title: Period integrals of distinguished polarised strongly tempered hyperspherical varieties
summary: Recent work of Mao, Wan and Zhang has provided a complete list of strongly tempered hyperspherical varieties and they proposed some new period integrals. In this paper, I will present new period integrals of distinguished polarised strongly tempered hyperspherical varieties and discuss the L-functions these integrals represent, as examples of the Relative Langlands Duality.
